verdict.rationale: Combined CPU+GPU offload is a fair question for a local inference runtime like LocalAI, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers CPU-only operation, automatic GPU backend detection and distributed GPU worker nodes. Nothing documents splitting a single model's layers between GPU VRAM and system RAM so that models larger than VRAM can run.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
